mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation models, directly increasing present values of future cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where FEDFUNDS declines for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals accelerating labor market deterioration, triggering recession fears that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where UNRATE increases >0.3pp MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.5% indicate a synchronized housing sector contraction, which precedes broader demand weakness and causes negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline >0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where RSAFS and HOUST both decline >0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 (2017=100 base) signals manufacturing contraction, which historically precedes economic slowdowns and generates negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential investment trend (RSAFS) with a 3-month moving average increase signals sustained household spending strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through improved economic confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where RSAFS has a 3-month moving average increase.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent price pressures that force the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, reducing equity risk appetite and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent month-over-month unemployment rate increases >0.2pp and non-farm payrolls declines >0.2% indicate accelerating labor market weakness, which strongly predicts recession and generates negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases >0.2pp MoM and PAYEMS declines >0.2% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE increases >0.2pp MoM and PAYEMS declines >0.2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: In strong GDP growth environments (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized), a housing starts decline below 1400 thousand units signals sector-specific demand cooling that triggers broader economic slowdown fears, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong GDP growth with housing slowdown
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized and HOUST < 1400.
